column1: # Sentences scripts/eval/make-clips.sh speaks with macOS `say`. Columns (tab-separated):
# id, text as written in its language's own script, romanised text. English rows (`en-*`) leave
# the romanised column empty. Hindi rows (`pure-*` plain Hindi, `mix-*` Hindi with English words)
# keep English words in Roman script inside the Devanagari text, which is how Hindi mode writes
# them; the romanised column is the Hinglish reference.
